items.answerHr: GNK ASG d.o.o. je korporativna i tehnološka platforma koja povezuje poslovanje, sport, umjetnu inteligenciju, tržišne informacije i razvoj digitalnih rješenja.
items.answerEn: GNK ASG d.o.o. is a corporate and technology platform connecting business, sport, artificial intelligence, market information and digital solutions.

items.answerHr: Možete koristiti kontakt obrazac na portalu, poslati poruku odgovarajućem odjelu ili zatražiti razgovor s odgovornom osobom.
items.answerEn: You can use the portal contact form, contact the relevant department or request a conversation with the responsible person.

items.answerHr: Automatske informacije dostupne su stalno. Upiti koji traže ljudsku obradu evidentiraju se i prosljeđuju odgovornoj osobi.
items.answerEn: Automated information is available continuously. Requests requiring human review are recorded and forwarded to the responsible person.
